description:
Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-86060: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.. Product: RouterOS

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_privilege_escalation_privilege_escalation_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cve%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%2026%') AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%CVE-%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%exploit%') AND "value" > 0
